discrete_when_available: state at stimulus_early, stimulus_late, and rating_early
per-epoch occupancy, transition matrices, persistence, switching, and path entropy
continuous_for_every_eligible_participan: PCA score vectors at each epoch
segment norms, total path length, direct displacement, directness ratio, and segment cosine when defined

null.scheme: within participant, independently permute trial linkage for stimulus_late and rating_early while preserving each epoch occupancy and keeping stimulus_early fixed
null.p_value: one-sided add-one randomization p-value for excess structured persistence/information

diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.qc_association: summarize QC by prespecified state after assignments are written; QC never enters primary state fit or K selection
diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.epoch_association: summarize residual epoch-family association after stage-centering; never revise states
diagnostic_only_after_state_lock.context_and_reports: forbidden in latent_state_fit; deferred to a separate post-hoc mapping phase after state assignments and trajectories are hashed
